tok 1.0 "Compliance audit"

pool org "Company"
  lane company "Company"
    start sched "Compliance audit scheduled"
    task docs "Prepare documentation"
    task evidence "Gather evidence"
    task self "Conduct self-assessment"
    and split
    and join
    task correct "Make corrections or improvements"
    task final "Undergo final audit"
    xor met "All criteria met?"
    task cert "Award certification"
    task issue "Issue official documents"
    end done "Certification issued"
    end failed "Certification not awarded"
  lane auditors "Auditors"
    task review "Review the company's processes"
    task gaps "Identify gaps or issues"

flow sched -> split
flow split -> docs -> join
flow split -> evidence -> join
flow join -> self -> review -> gaps -> correct -> final -> met
flow met -> cert "yes"
flow met -> failed "no"
flow cert -> issue -> done
